feeds.title: The Ring Finders Blog
feeds.description: Find stories of lost jewelry, lost rings, and lost watches by The Ring Finders members and metal detecting specialists. The Ring Finders Metal Detecting Service Inc. is a directory of independent metal detecting specialists around the world who can help you find lost jewelry, lost rings, lost watches, and more.

feeds.title: National Council for Metal Detecting News
feeds.description: News and insights from The National Council for Metal Detecting. The NCMD is recognised by the UK Government as being the official organisation representing the hobby of Metal Detecting in the UK.

feeds.title: Golden Detector Blog
feeds.description: We, Golden Detector company, offer you the best American, German, and Turkish raw gold detectors with international specifications and standards and with high quality and proven by all users of raw gold detectors around the world.

feeds.title: Orient Detectors Blog
feeds.description: We are the Orient Technology Group Company. A leading international company in the field of selling, manufacturing and trading of gold, mineral and groundwater detectors, as an exclusive agent and distributor approved by Major American and European companies specialized in this field.

feeds.title: Metal Detecting Tales
feeds.description: Metal Detecting Tales follows the pastimes of John Winter, a detectorist who retired from full-time work. Llearn from her experience and find regular posts about metal detecting matters - as well as other subjects that interest him.

feeds.title: Stout Standards
feeds.description: I have been involved in the treasure hunting/metal detecting pastime for over 45 years now, and this blog offers me a place and a reason to look back and put things in perspective. While my metal detecting experience is very much like yours, it took me on a somewhat different journey that changed a great many things in my life. Some good, some not so good but all worthy of a look back.

feeds.title: Coiltek Blog
feeds.description: We are a South Australian owned company who manufacture aftermarket accessories to suit Minelab metal detectors. We proudly provide the prospecting industry with excellent products, service and advice which helps optimise the opportunity of success. We continually improve our efforts and aim to help detectorists across the globe.

feeds.title: Metal Detecting Life
feeds.description: My name is Ace. Metal Detecting Life is a blog where I aim to help both the would-be pirate and everyday treasure hunter so that no matter what category you fall under, I'll be able to answer your questions as well as help expand your metal detecting arsenal so that you can get more enjoyment and better finds out of this wonderful hobby.

feeds.title: Treasure Beaches Report
feeds.description: Treasure Beaches Report is the Grandfather of Treasure/Metal Detecting Blogs. Find all things metal detecting.

feeds.title: UK Metal Detectors Blog
feeds.description: Metal Detectors UK Online Shop offers beginners to advanced machines, including C-Scope Metal Detectors!

feeds.title: Metal Detecting Tips
feeds.description: Metal Detecting has changed significantly in the last 10 years. Searching for treasure with good equipment has finally become attainable for everyone. The tough part is trying to understand how it all works. The mission of this website is to guide the beginner. No longer does it cost tens of thousands of dollars to really equip yourself.

feeds.title: Swing Beep Dig Repeat
feeds.description: Nick Colley is an avid Metal Detection enthusiast. His blog Swing Beep Dig Repeat is a record of his metal-detecting adventures, a showcase for some of his best finds, and a complete reference source for anyone interested in metal-detecting. Find exciting new finds and metal detecting tips in new posts.

feeds.title: Swinging Coils Family Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about starting out with a metal detector and the search for treasure. Read the blog to find tips and stories on metal detecting.

feeds.title: Treasure Hunting World » Metal Detector News
feeds.description: Treasure Hunting World is run by me, Saul Hudson.Saul shares his own thoughts and experiences about metal detecting as well as the latest industry news and reflects on what is happening in the hobby today.

feeds.title: Metal Detector Universe
feeds.description: Mike with his old, reliable Bounty Hunter 840 is a Metal Detector veteran having started detection in the 80s. He researches new products, meets new detectorists, and shares what he knows with anyone interested in metal detectors.

feeds.title: Dirt Girl Metal Detecting Blog
feeds.description: In January 2011, I bought a used Tesoro Cibola metal detector off Craigslist and ever since, have been obsessed with this new hobby, really my first hobby ever. Herein, I will describe my hunts, my finds, the metal detecting culture and try and figure out why this is so weirdly fun and addictive.

feeds.title: Sean Ward » Metal Detecting
feeds.description: Articles on metal detecting from Sean Ward. Sean is an avid metal detectorist and is always looking for new permissions. He loves the sense of discovery that comes from unearthing something lost or discarded, and the exercise and sun that comes along with it.

feeds.title: Metal Detector Planet Blog
feeds.description: My name is Nader. I am an industrial engineer. With my technical background, I can help you pick your next metal detector. These devices rely on electromagnetic fields, induced currents, conductivity.... to locate buried metals.

feeds.title: Serious Detecting Blog
feeds.description: Searching for high-quality metal detector equipment? Finding the right supplier online is vital. At Serious Detecting, we offer everything from state-of-the-art metal detectors to a wide range of prospecting tools.

feeds.title: Kellyco Metal Detectors Blog
feeds.description: Kellyco Metal Detecting Blog is an in-depth guide for metal detecting. You will find tips on the best metal detectors, accessories, and other helpful info. Kellyco Metal Detectors has provided customers worldwide with the best metal detectors and accessories for over 65 years.We offer the largest selection and best deals on metal detectors - guaranteed.

feeds.title: Detector Power Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Detector Power, your number one source for all metal detectors, outdoor sports and accessories. Founded in 2017 by four young adventure-lovers, we had (and still have) a vision of becoming a world-leader in professional metal detectors online.

feeds.title: MD-Hunter Blog
feeds.description: Common knowledge base on metal detectors, coils, pinpointers, manufacturers and simply useful information for treasure hunters.
